narration.full_text: Namaste students! Today, we're diving into the fascinating world of Control and Coordination. We'll explore how living organisms, both plants and animals, manage their activities and respond to their environment. By the end of this lesson, you will be able to define control and coordination and understand their importance, differentiate between the nervous and endocrine systems in animals, explain the structure and function of neurons and the nervous system, describe reflex actions and the reflex arc, identify the main parts and functions of the human brain. You will also understand coordination and tropic movements in plants, explore hormonal control in animals and the endocrine system, and learn about different plant hormones and their specific roles.
